The structure of Hg4Cd2S8 (reduced formula Hg2CdS4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4mm (No. 107), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd centers coordinated by four S neighbors, Hg centers by four S neighbors, and S centers in two distinct environments, one with two Cd and two Hg neighbors and another with four Hg neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is two-dimensional, forming a single 14-site component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner-sharing between 4-vertex S polyhedra and between 4-vertex Hg polyhedra, though these relations are not exclusive.
